neighbours.label: a determiner (' the', ' their', ' this') as the object of a verb of doing, after a verb that performs something (doing the activity, lay their eggs, live their lives, I wrote this), as opposed to sentences with no such object
fire: Cover the desks or consider doing the experiment outdoors.
These seals hunt in the water and spend their whole lives there.
Frogs lay their eggs and hide in ponds.
You'll get mad at me because I said this!
The workers did their shift in tunnels and pits.
Birds build their nests and feed in hedges.
I think it will snow now because I wrote this.
The students read their poems and sang in class.
quiet: The desks are under the window in the classroom.
These seals were born in the water near the rocks.
Frogs are small animals with long legs.
You'll get wet because it is raining outside.
The workers went home from the tunnels at noon.
Birds were singing in the hedges at dawn.
I think it will snow now because it is cold.
The students went to class at nine.

notes: Probes 0.18–0.65. Non-English 'ejercer' on the card is not tested. Very general label; the peak token is common, and the corpus top is mixed.
